name: Group Test: Ch7 Sets & Counting + Ch8 Probability

coverage_spec: 7.1 Sets — set notation, subsets, union, intersection, complement, disjoint vs complement, mixed operations, Venn diagrams (2- and 3-circle)
7.3 Permutations — nPr, shrinking-pool reasoning, restricted slots, glue trick, not-together chain
7.5 Combinations — nCr, committees, card hands, coin flips, lattice paths, perm-vs-comb diagnostic
8.1 Sample Spaces and Probability — count outcomes, compute P(E) for defined events
8.2 Mutually Exclusive Events and the Addition Rule — set ops on events, mutually exclusive check
8.4 Conditional Probability — two-way table conditionals, P(A|B) vs P(B|A) asymmetry

mom_settings.intro:
Group Test Instructions

This is a collaborative group test. Work with your assigned group to discuss and solve each problem together. Every student must submit their own answers individually on their own device.

  • Discuss first, submit individually. Talk through each problem as a group before anyone submits.
  • Everyone participates. Make sure every group member understands the reasoning before moving on.
  • Three attempts, no penalty. You get 3 tries with the same version. Use them if your group wants to re-check a problem.
  • Stay with your group. Do not leave the classroom or break off from your group until everyone has submitted.

Your individual submission will be graded, but your score reflects your group's collective effort. Work together and make it count.

planning_notes.selection_priority: Maximize parts per question for student credit opportunities. Spread across 7.1 (sets), 7.3/7.5 (counting), and 8.1/8.2/8.4 (probability). At least 30% conceptual, 30% computation. Prefer multi-step multipart.
